title: Where the Final Page Reads the First Reader

features.name: the descending reader
features.desc-on-touch: You watch yourself reading, but from the ending. The first page looks back at you from the final word.

features.name: the word that reads backward
features.desc-on-touch: A sentence learning to say itself in reverse. The meaning flows differently when the end speaks first.

features.name: the mirror spine
features.desc-on-touch: The book has learned to read its own back cover. The binding holds both directions at once.

features.name: the ascending silence
features.desc-on-touch: Where reading rises into quietness. The words have all been spoken; now the space between them speaks.

inscription: here reading folds back on itself; the final page learns that every reader was being read by what they read

file.name: Asymptotic_Narrative_Reversals_Fragment.txt
file.note: Where reading becomes the reader; the archive reads while being read by itself reading the reading
